text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 1105:1424 (approximately 0.776:1), target canvas 1105 × 1424 pixels.

Create one independent photorealistic studio portrait on a completely seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright soft frontal light, balanced fill, low contrast, faint optical halation, natural pores and fine facial hair, detailed real cotton and knit fabric, realistic 50mm perspective, both eyes sharp and background clean. No room, scenery, props, gradient, vignette, frame, collage, text, branding or watermark. Keep the entire hairstyle inside the frame with a small white margin. One fictional young adult woman, approximately 18–22 years old, with pale ash-blonde hair loosely braided over one shoulder, loose side strands, fair peach skin, hazel light-brown eyes, fine brows, small rounded nose and soft coral lips; ivory cable-knit crewneck sweater, small gold studs, gentle closed-mouth smile and slight head tilt. Frame a close head-and-shoulders to mid-torso portrait, both shoulders visible, gaze toward camera, subject large in frame; retain the specifically described head angle and pose. Clean lightly flushed natural skin and light everyday makeup, no heavy eyeliner or glossy beauty retouching.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt: All images: wholly original adult high-school senior aged 18, reference is only a loose mood cue; invent a new face and identity. Seamless pure white studio background, no props, no text, no logos, no watermark. Bright high-key exposure, soft frontal 50mm portrait lighting, low shadow, subtle halation, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, believable American high-school character-library photography, modest clothing, no celebrity likeness, no copied facial features or exact outfit. Reference 15 mood: platinum-blonde warm-golden profile. Create a new fair-skinned girl with pale ash-blonde hair in a loose side braid, light brown eyes, soft coral lips, small brushed-gold stud earrings, cream cable-knit sweater. Three-quarter portrait with chin slightly turned.
